note: logs.run is a demo of the openstatus 'Data Table with Filters' component (shadcn/ui + TanStack Table): the whole host 302s to data-table.openstatus.dev, and the demo/config pages keep the logs.run URL (https://logs.run/default → 200, 2026-10-07). No sitemap; urls_from "/" is the only index — its relative links give the six table configs (/default, /light, /infinite, /auto, /builder, /drizzle = demo variants of the one table component) plus nine /docs/<name> pages of the same library. Everything is the table element; the demo pages are why granularity is page rather than example.
